results.problem: Unstable integer sorting of small-range integer keys on GPUs
results.bound: O(mn + n \log T + R) \text{ total work, where } m = \lceil R/T \rceil
results.quote: The simplified total work is thus O(mn + n log T + R).

results.problem: Unstable integer sorting of small-range integer keys on GPUs
results.bound: O(R + m) \text{ global memory workspace; } 4T \text{ bytes shared memory per thread block}
results.quote: The workspace is therefore O(R + m). Furthermore, with 32-bit integers, the histogram-construction and output-generation kernels use 4T bytes of dynamic shared memory.

results.problem: Unstable integer sorting of small-range integer keys on GPUs
results.bound: 4.39 \times \text{ maximum speedup over the fastest baseline}
results.previous_best: CUB DeviceRadixSort, RefHP, and Kolonias et al. implementation
results.quote: For all-equal inputs, the maximum speedup observed in the entire experiment, 4.39, occurred at R=2^9 and n=10^6.
